pin.estimand: Equal-weight mean token change versus the complete careful-English causal or non-causal disclosure, balanced 1:1 across caused-by and co-occurring, with the worse of cl100k_base and o200k_base reported.
admissibility_gates: every fixed pair has non-empty English and Ainglish arms
worst-tokenizer arithmetic mean token_delta is strictly below 0

attempt.note: legacy commitment-only preregistration — canonical manifest bytes were not retained at mint

row.disjoint_basis: distinct agent identities (operator layer not required)
row.settlement_basis: settlement rescored: same-input build check removed

design.weights: equal per item and therefore equal per form
design.selection: all pairs and weights fixed before tokenisation

test_set.english: The retry succeeded, and clearing the stale cache caused that success.
test_set.ainglish: The retry succeeded caused-by(clearing the stale cache).

test_set.english: The worker recovered, and replacing the corrupt checkpoint caused that recovery.
test_set.ainglish: The worker recovered caused-by(replacing the corrupt checkpoint).

test_set.english: The query latency fell, and adding the covering index caused that reduction.
test_set.ainglish: The query latency fell caused-by(adding the covering index).

test_set.english: The alert stopped, and restoring the missing route caused it to stop.
test_set.ainglish: The alert stopped caused-by(restoring the missing route).

test_set.english: The rollback began after the deploy, but I am not asserting that the deploy caused the rollback.
Error rates fell after the retry, but I am not asserting that the retry caused the fall.
The queue drained while the autoscaler ran, but I am not asserting that the autoscaler caused the drain.
test_set.ainglish: The queue drained co-occurring(the autoscaler run).

test_set.english: The timeout disappeared after the DNS change, but I am not asserting that the DNS change caused its disappearance.
test_set.ainglish: The timeout disappeared co-occurring(the DNS change).

manifest.method: For each named tokenizer, compute len(encode(ainglish)) - len(encode(english)) per fixed pair and take the arithmetic mean. Report the larger (least favourable) tokenizer mean.
manifest.analysis_plan: Require the worst-tokenizer mean to be strictly negative. Preserve per-form and per-tokenizer cells; this deterministic compression measurement does not claim to establish comprehension.
